translations.ron: Dar Iov iarăşi a vorbit şi a zis:

verses.geez: አእመርኩ፡ ከመ፡ እምእዴየ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘለፋየ፡ ወአክበደ፡ እዴሁ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ወአግዐረኒ።
verses.translation: Yea, I know that pleading is out of my reach; and his hand has been made heavy upon my groaning.

translations.lxx: Yea, I know that pleading is out of my reach; and his hand has been made heavy upon my groaning.
translations.kjv: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
translations.ron: "Şi de data aceasta plângerea mea este luată tot ca răzvrătire şi totuşi mâna mea de-abia înăbuşe suspinele mele.
translations.grk: Καὶ δὴ οἶδα ὅτι ἐκ χειρός μου ἡ ἔλεγξίς ἐστι, καὶ ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ βαρεῖα γέγονεν ἐπʼ ἐμῷ στεναγμῷ.

verses.geez: ምንት፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘኢየአምር፡ ከመ፡ እርከብ፡ ወእብጻሕ፡ እስከ፡ ለዝሉፉ።
verses.translation: Who would then know that I might find him, and come to an end of the matter?

translations.lxx: Who would then know that I might find him, and come to an end of the matter?
translations.kjv: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
translations.ron: O, dacă aş şti unde să-L găsesc! Dacă aş putea să ajung la palatul Lui!
translations.grk: Τίς δʼ ἄρα γνοίη, ὅτι εὕροιμι αὐτὸν, καὶ ἔλθοιμι εἰς τέλος;

verses.geez: ወይንግረኒ፡ እመቦ፡ ዘገበርኩ፡ ወኢያረምም፡ አፉየ፡ እንዘ፡ እወቅስ።
verses.translation: And I would plead my own cause, and he would fill my mouth with arguments.

translations.lxx: And I would plead my own cause, and he would fill my mouth with arguments.
translations.kjv: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
translations.ron: Atunci aş dezvălui înaintea Lui pricina mea şi aş umple gura mea cu învinuiri.
translations.grk: Εἴποιμι δὲ ἐμαυτοῦ κρίμα, τὸ δὲ στόμα μου ἐμπλήσαι ἐλέγχων.

verses.geez: ወአምር፡ ሊተሂ፡ ከመ፡ ይሁበኒ፡ ፈውሰ፡ ወለበውኩ፡ ዘይሁበኒ።
verses.translation: And I would know the remedies which he would speak to me, and I would perceive what he would tell me.

translations.lxx: And I would know the remedies which he would speak to me, and I would perceive what he would tell me.
translations.kjv: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
translations.ron: Aş şti atunci cuvintele cu care mi-ar răspunde şi aş înţelege rostul spuselor Lui.
translations.grk: Γνοίην δὲ ἰάματα ἅ μοι ἐρεῖ, αἰσθοίμην δὲ τίνα μοι ἀπαγγελεῖ.

verses.geez: ወእመሂ፡ በብዙኅ፡ ኃይል፡ ይመጽሕ፡ ኢይገብር፡ እንከ፡ በመዓቱ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ እስመ፡ ሣህል፡ ወጻድቅ፡ ኀቤሁ።
verses.translation: Though he should come on me in his great strength, then he would not threaten me;

translations.lxx: Though he should come on me in his great strength, then he would not threaten me;
translations.kjv: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
translations.ron: Şi-ar dezlănţui El oare toată puterea în cearta Lui cu mine? Nu, El ar sta şi m-ar asculta.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν πολλῇ ἰσχύϊ ἐπελεύσεταί μοι, εἶτα ἐν ἀπειλῇ μοι οὐ χρήσεται.

verses.geez: ወያዐርፈኒ፡ ለዝሉፉ፡ እምኵነኔየ፡ እስመ፡ ኀበ፡ ቀዲሙ።
verses.translation: for truth and reproof are from him; and he would bring forth my judgment to an end.

translations.lxx: for truth and reproof are from him; and he would bring forth my judgment to an end.
translations.kjv: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
translations.ron: El ar lua aminte la omul drept care vorbeşte în fala Lui şi astfel aş fi iertat pe vecie de Judecătorul meu.
translations.grk: Ἀλήθεια γὰρ καὶ ἔλεγχος παρʼ αὐτοῦ, ἐξαγάγοι δὲ εἰς τέλος τὸ κρίμα μου.

verses.translation: For if I shall go first, and exist no longer, still what do I know concerning the latter end?

translations.lxx: For if I shall go first, and exist no longer, still what do I know concerning the latter end?
translations.kjv: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
translations.ron: Căci iată, dacă o iau spre răsărit, El nu este acolo; dacă o iau spre apus, nu-L zăresc!
translations.grk: Εἰ γὰρ πρῶτος πορεύσομαι, καὶ οὐκ ἔτι εἰμὶ, τὰ δὲ ἐπʼ ἐσχάτοις, τί οἶδα;

verses.geez: እገብእ፡ እንከ፡ መንገለ፡ ጸጋም፡ ወእትመየጥ፡ መንገለ፡ የማን፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘእሬኢ።
verses.translation: When he wrought on the left hand, then I observed it not: his right hand shall encompass me but I shall not see it.

translations.lxx: When he wrought on the left hand, then I observed it not: his right hand shall encompass me but I shall not see it.
translations.kjv: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
translations.ron: L-am căutat spre miazănoapte şi n-am dat de El, m-am întors către miazăzi şi nici aici nu L-am văzut!
translations.grk: Ἀριστερὰ ποιήσαντος αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ κατέσχον, περιβαλεῖ δεξιὰ καὶ οὐκ ὄψομαι·

verses.geez: ወእደ፡ አእምር፡ ፍኖትየ፡ ወፈተነኒ፡ ከመ፡ ወርቅ።
verses.translation: For he knows already my way; and he has tried me as gold.

translations.lxx: For he knows already my way; and he has tried me as gold.
translations.kjv: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
translations.ron: Dar El cunoaşte şi umbletul meu şi starea mea pe loc şi dacă ar fi să mă treacă prin cuptor de foc, voi ieşi din cuptor curat ca aurul.
translations.grk: Οἶδε γὰρ ἤδη ὁδόν μου· διέκρινε δέ με ὥσπερ τὸ χρυσίον.

verses.translation: And I will go forth according to his commandments, for I have kept his ways; and I shall not turn aside from his commandments,

translations.lxx: And I will go forth according to his commandments, for I have kept his ways; and I shall not turn aside from his commandments,
translations.kjv: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
translations.ron: M-am ţinut cu pasul meu după pasul Lui, am păzit calea Lui şi nu m-am abătut din ea.
translations.grk: Ἐξελεύσομαι δὲ ἐν ἐντάλμασιν αὐτοῦ, ὁδοὺς γὰρ αὐτοῦ ἐφύλαξα, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκκλίνω ἀπὸ ἐνταλμάτων αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez: ወኢኀለፍኩ፡ እምትእዛዙ፡ ወኀባእኩ፡ ነገሮ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕፅንየ።
verses.translation: neither shall I transgress; but I have hid his words in my bosom.

translations.lxx: neither shall I transgress; but I have hid his words in my bosom.
translations.kjv: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
translations.ron: De la porunca buzelor Sale nu m-am depărtat, la sânul meu am ţinut ascunse cuvintele gurii Sale.
translations.grk: καὶ οὐ μὴ παρέλθω, ἐν δὲ κόλπῳ μου ἔκρυψα ῥήματα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይትዋቀሶ፡ በእንተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይፈቀደ፡ ይገብር።
verses.translation: And if too he has thus judged, who is he that has contradicted, for he has both willed a thing and done it.

translations.lxx: And if too he has thus judged, who is he that has contradicted, for he has both willed a thing and done it.
translations.kjv: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
translations.ron: Dar hotărârea Lui este luată şi cine-L va împiedica? Căci ceea ce sufletul Său a poftit, aceea va şi face.
translations.grk: Εἰ δὲ καὶ αὐτὸς ἔκρινεν οὕτως, τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἀντειπὼν αὐτῷ; ὁ γὰρ αὐτὸς ἠθέλησε, καὶ ἐποίησε.

verses.geez: ወበእንተዝ፡ አነሂ፡ ጐጓእኩ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ወተገሢዕየ፡ ሐለይክዎ።

translations.kjv: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
translations.ron: Fiindcă El aduce la îndeplinire hotărârea Sa şi alte foarte multe lucruri la fel, care sunt în gândul Său.

verses.geez: ወበእንተዝ፡ ደንገፅኩ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ እሔልዮሂ፡ ወይጌርመኒ።
verses.translation: Therefore am I troubled at him; and when I was reproved, I thought of him.

translations.lxx: Therefore let me take good heed before him: I will consider, and be afraid of him.
translations.kjv: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
translations.ron: Iată pentru ce sunt înspăimântat în faţa Lui. Mă gândesc şi mi-e teamă de El.
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἐσπούδακα· νουθετούμενος δὲ, ἐφρόντισα αὐτοῦ. Ἐπὶ τούτῳ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ κατασπουδασθῶ· κατανοήσω, καὶ πτοηθήσομαι ἐξ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእግዚአብሔር፡ መሰዎ፡ ለልብየ፡ ወዘኵሎ፡ ይመልከ፡ አጐጕዓኒ።
verses.translation: But the Lord has softened my heart, and the Almighty has troubled me.

translations.lxx: But the Lord has softened my heart, and the Almighty has troubled me.
translations.kjv: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
translations.ron: Dumnezeu a slăbit inima mea şi Cel Atotputernic m-a îngrozit.
translations.grk: Κύριος δὲ ἐμαλάκυνε τὴν καρδίαν μου· ὁ δὲ παντοκράτωρ ἐσπούδασέ με.

verses.geez: በእይቴ፡ አእመርኩ፡ ከመ፡ ትመጽአኒ፡ ጽልመት፡ ወደፈነኒ፡ ቆባር፡ ውስተ፡ ገጽየ።
verses.translation: For I knew not that darkness would come upon me, and thick darkness has covered me before my face.

translations.lxx: For I knew not that darkness would come upon me, and thick darkness has covered me before my face.
translations.kjv: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
translations.ron: Şi n-am tăcut din pricina întunericului şi din pricina nopţii care a învăluit faţa mea.
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ ᾔδειν ὅτι ἐπελεύσεταί μοι σκότος, πρὸ προσώπου δέ μου ἐκάλυψε γνόφος.
